At work, when I’m doing home visits, I keep thinking I’m bringing some parasite back with me and that it’s eating me from the inside.

I also feel things crawling on my skin, especially at night—little pricks and movements along my arms and legs, like bugs under the surface. When I turn on the light, there’s nothing there, but the feeling is so real it keeps me from sleeping.

Sometimes, especially earlier on, I’d go through these brief bursts where I’d feel oddly energized and talkative, starting big projects at home and staying up late sorting case files, feeling like I could handle everything. But those spells only lasted a few days here and there, and this sense that my body is diseased and the crawling sensations has been constant.

Lately at work and even here, I sometimes just…stop talking. I know people are speaking to me, but I just sit there, barely answering, like the words get stuck.
